quality_review.review_method: Deterministic query-stratified sample (20 first-query, 20 second-query-only, 10 third-query-only records). AI-assisted review of original ClinicalTrials.gov API fields; source status values were preserved and mapping was checked separately.
quality_review.notes: Audit completed; unresolved scope and UNKNOWN-status records remain held. The stratified sample is not a prevalence estimate and does not independently verify that a registry status is still current today. See quality-review-2026-10-02.md.

reuse_review.notes: Being publicly searchable or downloadable does not by itself establish permission to republish registry metadata.
